title: Lost Mary BM6000 Double Apple Prefilled Vape Pods
description: Double Apple pairs the crisp sweetness of Red Apple with the slightly tart bite of Green Apple. This balanced combination delivers a fresh, juicy, and satisfying apple flavour with a smooth and authentic-tasting finish. Designed for use with the Lost Mary BM6000 V2 Prefilled Pod Kit , this pack includes a replaceable 2ml prefilled pod and a 10ml refill container, allowing you to refresh your device with ease. This system extends the lifespan of your device, providing up to 6000 puffs while offering the flexibility to switch flavours at any time. How to Use Your Replacement Pod & Refill Pack: 1. Remove the prefilled pod and refill container from the packaging. 2. Remove any safety stickers from the components. 3. Insert the pod securely into the device. 4. Attach the refill container to the side of the device. 5. Turn the device upside down to transfer e-liquid from the refill container to the pod. 6. Allow a few minutes for the coil to saturate before vaping. When the pod and refill container are empty, simply replace them with a new set to continue enjoying your Lost Mary BM6000 V2 device. Browse the complete selection of BM6000 refill pods and find your favourite.
